title: RedLightGreenLight by Vincergy
body:
**🎮 Vincergy RLGL – Red Light Green Light Plugin**

Bring the Squid Game experience to your Minecraft server with a fully featured Red Light, Green Light plugin!

Supports both server-wide gameplay and arena-based minigames, with advanced customization, setup tools, and smooth gameplay systems.

- **✨ Features**
- 🌍 Global Mode (entire server plays)
- 🏟️ Arena Mode (joinable minigames)
- 🧠 Setup Wizard (easy step-by-step setup)
- 🪵 Selection Tools (set regions & lines with sticks)
- 🎒 Inventory system (arena-safe inventory)
- 👁️ Spectator mode with boundaries
- 📊 PlaceholderAPI support
- 🎁 Rewards system
- ⏱️ Lobby countdown + game timer
- 📢 Titles & bossbars
- 🏁 Start & finish line system
- 🌍 Global Mode
Entire server participates automatically
Uses player’s current inventory
Optional keep inventory setting

Perfect for events and chaos gameplay 🔥

**🏟️ Arena Mode**

Players can join specific arenas:

/rlgl join <arena>

Includes:

- Lobby system
- Countdown before game starts
- Arena spawn system
- Start line & finish line
- Spectator system
- Inventory saving & restoring

**🧱 Easy Setup (Wizard)**

Use:

/rlgl wizard <arena>

The wizard guides you through:

- Setting lobby
- Setting spawn
- Choosing life mode
- Setting duration
- Creating arena region
- Creating start line
- Creating finish line
- Setting spectator bounds
- Enabling arena

✔ Fully clickable in chat
✔ Updates automatically after each step

**🪵 Setup Tools**

All setup tools work the same:

Right click → Position 1  
Right click → Position 2  
Left click (punch the ground) → Confirm  

After confirming:

- Selection is saved
- Tool disappears
- Tools
- /rlgl regionstick <arena>
- /rlgl startlinestick <arena>
- /rlgl finishstick <arena>
- /rlgl spectatorstick <arena>
  
**🎮 Gameplay**
- Game Start
  
- Arena flow:
  
- RED LIGHT, GREEN LIGHT
- Game is about to begin
- 3
- 2
- 1
- Green Light
  
Players can move after Green Light appears.

🔴 Red Light / 🟢 Green Light
Green Light → Move freely
Red Light → Movement = punishment

Titles appear for both states.

**🏁 Winning**
- Cross the finish line to win
- Multiple players can win
- Winners go into spectator mode
- 💀 Life Modes
- CONTINUOUS
- Players respawn and keep playing
- No flawless reward
- ONE LIFE
- One death = elimination
- Player becomes spectator
- 👁️ Spectator Mode
- Activated on death or finish
- Restricted to arena area
- Still see bossbar (remaining time)
- 🎒 Arena Inventory System
- On join → inventory is saved & cleared
- On leave/end → inventory is restored

**📊 Placeholders**
**Supports PlaceholderAPI**

Examples:

- %rlgl_arena_wins%
- %rlgl_deaths%
- %rlgl_current_arena%
- %rlgl_remaining_time%

Leaderboard support included.

**🎁 Rewards**

Fully configurable:

Arena win rewards
Flawless rewards
Optional participation rewards

**📜 Commands**
General
- /rlgl help
- /rlgl status
- /rlgl reload
  Game Control
- /rlgl start global <time>
- /rlgl start arena <arena>
- /rlgl stop
- /rlgl test <arena>
  Player
- /rlgl join <arena>
- /rlgl leave
- Arena Management
- /rlgl arena create <name>
- /rlgl arena delete <name>
- /rlgl arena list
- /rlgl arena enable <name>

**Setup**
/rlgl wizard <arena>
/rlgl arena setlobby <arena>
/rlgl arena setspawn <arena>
/rlgl arena duration <arena> <time>
/rlgl arena lifemode <arena> <mode>

**🔐 Permissions**
- rlgl.admin
- rlgl.join
- rlgl.leave
- rlgl.arena.create
- rlgl.arena.edit
- rlgl.arena.start
- rlgl.arena.stop
- rlgl.global.start
- rlgl.reload

**⚠️ Notes**
- Finish line crossing = win (not just entering a region)
- Start line prevents early movement
- Wizard is recommended for setup
- Designed for performance and stability
  

**💡 Perfect for:**

- Minigame servers
- Events
- Squid Game inspired gameplay
- Competitive arenas
